mechanism: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing naltrexone metabolism and reducing its opioid antagonist efficacy; concurrent use may also increase CNS depression and serotonergic effects.
action: Monitor for reduced naltrexone efficacy in alcohol use disorder or opioid use disorder treatment; consider alternative antidepressant or increased naltrexone dosing; counsel patient to avoid concurrent use if possible.
